name: Protective-earth terminal block
summary: A PE terminal provides a documented protective-conductor connection, often including a specified connection to the mounting rail.
description: A PE terminal provides a documented protective-conductor connection, often including a specified connection to the mounting rail. The circuit and terminal plan must show the bonding path actually relied upon.
readingNotes: Trace the protective path to the assembly's earth connection.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
